summary: Quantum Cyber N.V. filed Form 8-K reporting the second closing of a private investment by David E. Lazar, issuing Series D and E preferred shares convertible into up to 225 million ordinary shares for $3 million. This second closing, completed April 22, 2026, represented over 90% of the fully diluted ordinary shares, effectively granting control. The first closing of Series A, B, and C preferred shares occurred February 17, 2026 for another $3 million. This dilutive financing is not a standard M&A, tender offer, or going-private transaction; it is a structured equity issuance leading to a change of control. Watch for shareholder approval requirements and potential Nasdaq listing compliance issues.
